## Dispatch — `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`), round R33

Claimed: objectstack-ai/objectui#9274 — dispatched to an `os-dev` seat by the `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`) at R33.
Clause-②: yes

### ⛔ The triage comment on this card is **BINDING** — read it in full first (rule 38)
It carries the **p1** grading with its three-way comparison, the seven-point acceptance, one **product judgement you must make and pin**, one **NOT MEASURED** it declares, and a falsifiable premise with a fork. This dispatch does not restate it and does not override it. Where they differ, it wins.

### ⭐ Premise re-verified at this seat before dispatch (rule 52)
⛔ I do not dispatch on a card's word any more — a card ruled days ago can already have been delivered. Read on `origin/main` just now:

```
ReportDefaultInspector.tsx:302   const chartTitle = typeof chart.title === 'string' ? (chart.title as string) : '';
ReportDefaultInspector.tsx:304   const next = { ...chart, ...patch };
ReportDefaultInspector.tsx:455   onCommit={(v) => commitChart({ title: v || undefined })}
packages/i18n/src/pickLocalized.ts:36    export function pickLocalized(value, language): string
packages/i18n/src/pickLocalized.ts:142   export function setLocalized(
```

⇒ **all three defect sites and both repair halves are live.** ⛔ Nothing is missing but the call.

### ⭐ Why this is p1 — so you know what you are protecting
Two halves that **fail in opposite directions and amplify each other**:
1. **The read half shows nothing** — the map arm fails the narrowing, so Studio paints an **EMPTY** Title box over a report that has a title. The author is shown the absence of the thing they authored.
2. **The write half destroys it** — the shallow merge puts a plain string **in place of the whole map**; every other locale is gone.

⭐ **The damage does not need a mistake**: the surface *invites* the author to retype a title it told them was missing, and the retype is what drops every language they were not looking at. Worse still, **committing the empty box untouched sends `v || undefined`, which deletes the stored map outright.** ⇒ ordinary trigger · silent · **unrecoverable**.

### ⛔ Use the existing pair. Do NOT write merge logic.
- Read: **`pickLocalized(chart.title, activeLanguage)`**.
- Write: **`setLocalized(chart.title, v, activeLanguage)`**.
⭐ `setLocalized`'s own doc comment says it exists **for this exact failure** — *"`onChange(e.target.value)` straight back over `{ en, zh-CN }` destroys every locale the author was not looking at, silently, on the first keystroke"* — and it deliberately stops short of the display-only fallback limbs, so an author editing in `fr` while shown the `en` string **cannot overwrite English**. ⛔ Hand-rolling a merge would lose that property silently.

### ⭐⭐ Three things the acceptance pins hard
1. ⭐ **Assert on the COMMITTED PATCH, ⛔ not just on the input box.** This is the card's crux: *the box looking right is the defect's own symptom*. A pin that only reads the input passes against the bug.
2. ⭐ **You must RULE and PIN the clearing semantics.** Clearing a multi-locale title's *current* locale — does it delete that entry, or the whole map? Today's behaviour is the latter (`v || undefined` + shallow merge). ⚠️ Triage explicitly did **not** rule this and ⛔ **you may not inherit today's behaviour as the default**. Choose, say why in the PR, and pin it. If you judge it a product decision above your floor, **stop and report** and I will route it.
3. ⭐ **The siblings are a MUST-CHECK, not a nicety.** `subtitle` / `description` sit on the same union in the same inspector. ⛔ Repairing only `title` leaves two instances of the identical defect. Measure them; repair or explicitly fence them with a reason.

### ⛔ Boundaries
- ⛔ This is **not** objectui#9150 and **not** its residue. That was a **read** site in `@object-ui/plugin-report` that drew no heading; this is a **read + write** site in `@object-ui/app-shell` that loses stored data. ⛔ Do not touch the renderer.
- ⚠️ Triage declares **NOT MEASURED**: the spec side (`ReportChartSchema.title` as `I18nLabel`) — `@objectstack/spec` is not installed in that container, so the union is taken from the card's own measurement. ⭐ **You should verify it**, and say which way it read.
- ⚠️ The card's own falsifiable premise: *inline locale-map titles are actually used in real reports*. ⛔ Nobody has censused the spelling's real usage. If your own reading falsifies it, ⛔ do not silently downgrade — **report it** (triage's fork is p2, defect intact, nobody stepping on it).

### Standing constraints for this round
- Read `AGENTS.md` in full before your first edit. ⛔ `packages/components/src/ui/**/*.tsx` is a **No-Touch zone** (Commandment #7).
- ⛔ Never skip, disable or quarantine a test. ⛔ Never force-push or rewrite pushed history.
- **Changeset required.** 41 packages in ONE `fixed` group ⇒ `major` unavailable; breaking ships as `minor` with a `**BREAKING**` carrier. Justify by **measurement**. ⚠️ Authoring behaviour changes here — say what an author who does nothing differently now gets.
- ⚠️ There is **no npm script matching `no-major`**; the script file is real and runs inside **`changeset:check`**. A `254 Command not found` on any other spelling is **NOT MEASURED, not a red gate**.
- objectui has **no** `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`; derive the gate family by hand from `package.json` + `.github/workflows/`.
- ⚠️ **A package-scoped run is not the blast radius** (objectui#9273); run `examples/schema-catalog/` and grep count-shaped and prose figures.
- ⚠️⚠️ **A declared narrowing of your verification union can still be the load-bearing one.** This lane just paid for that: a seat excluded `@object-ui/site` as "a docs app", and `apps/site` both declares `type-check` **and** depends on the package under change — CI went red exactly there. ⭐ Before trusting any exclusion, do a **membership read** of the dependent set plus a look at the excluded package's own `scripts`.
- ⚠️ **Install/build first.** A missing `node_modules` makes every `require.resolve` fail identically — **instrument failure, not a negative answer**. Read verdicts from the verify-lock wrapper's VERDICT line, never a bare `$?`.
- ⚠️ **Carrier rule (directional):** hang `needs:contract-review` on **both** limbs in one stroke. ⛔ **Never clear either limb**; clearing is the PM's. (REST label POST needs `Content-Type: application/json`, else **415** — ⛔ not a permission failure.)
- ⚠️ **In flight:** PR objectui#9310 (`packages/react`, `packages/fields`, `apps/site`) is open and **held** on objectui#9311; objectui#9294 and objectui#9304 go out this round. ⛔ Check before editing outside `app-shell`.
- ⛔ No model identifier in any pushed artifact; ⛔ don't copy a neighbouring commit's trailer (this repo's history is inconsistent on it) — use the model-free form. ⛔ Card relations belong in the **PR body**, not the commit message.

### ⭐ The two instrument standards this seat holds
1. **Write the pin BEFORE the code** — the "unmodified" arm is then the real base tree. ⭐ Here the base arm is vivid: the pin should show the empty box **and** the destroyed map on today's tree.
2. **Every control must be able to fire.** The plain-string title is the lit control — it must read **identically** before and after. ⛔ A pin built only on it cannot fail.
